checks.what: Page: Seventeen Point Agreement 'signed ... on 23 May 1951'; Central Tibet 'came under the control of the People's Republic of China'; footnote: Central Tibet included 'the western part of Kham corresponding to the Chamdo Region'; Chamdo captured 'by 19 October' 1950. Year/month/parties match (PRC ledger/7-8 and Tibet's dissolve are also 1951-05). Region Xizang (4,342 cells) is wider than the land, but a gain takes only the counterpart's cells: the trial moves exactly the 686 Tibet-held cells under PRC occupation since Oct 1950; Tibet keeps nothing at its dissolve, the occupation closes in 1951, no 1951-52 hole left.

Page: 'On August 16, 1945, a border agreement between Poland and the USSR was signed'; 'The Belastok Region was divided into Soviet Brest Region, Grodno Region and Polish Białystok Voivodeship'. The land is Polish by 1950, so the event is supported; it is dated 1950-01 as a stand-in for the August 1945 transfer (previous window; honest note). Gain takes only BSSR-held cells inside Poland: the trial moves 107 cells (not 101). Side effect: Poland's own 1953 keyframe snap now releases 6 of these Bug-border cells (23.2-23.9E, 52.1-53.4N) to nobody for 1953-59 (before: BSSR's); p1960-p1969 events/1 takes nobody's land in its region from 1960. Net gain clearly positive; see problems.

Page: 'On 1 November 1956, Madhya Bharat, together with the states of Vindhya Pradesh and Bhopal State, was merged into Madhya Pradesh'. Region (588 cells) is the madhya-bharat dossier's own region; the trial moves all 578 Madhya Bharat cells to India in 1956-11, nothing left to nobody. (578 cells = 146,000 km2 against the page's 120,380 km2 is the dossier's shape, not this entry.)

Page: 'On 1 November 1956 Travancore-Cochin was joined with Malabar District of Madras State to form the new state of Kerala'; 'Devikulam - Peermade and Neyyattinkara Taluks were merged with the newly formed Kerala state'. Region is the dossier's dissolve region (79 cells); trial moves all 79 to India in 1956-11.

Page: 'the four southern taluks of Travancore namely Thovalai, Agastheeswaram, Kalkulam and Vilavancode' merged with Madras State, with part of Sengottai, 1 November 1956. Region (12 cells: Kanyakumari 35 km + Sengottai 15 km) only takes Travancore-Cochin's cells: 11 moved to India; together with events/3 all 90 cells of the state go to India, none to nobody.

Page: 'The British continued to administer the area until 1 April 1950'; 'On 1 April 1950, the Amministrazione fiduciaria italiana della Somalia (AFIS) began its rule'. Region country Somalia (2,069 cells) has no overlap with Natural Earth's Somaliland (checked: intersection 0 cells), so British Somaliland stays British. Trial: British Africa releases the territory in 1950-04; no later snap touches Somalia cells in 1950-59.

Page: a 'United Nations Trust Territory from 1950 to 1960' under Italian administration, AFIS rule from 1 April 1950 (UNGA Resolution 289 of 21 November 1949). Occupation of unowned land is an interim stand-in for a trusteeship (dossier request filed by the window); trial: Italy's occupation covers 2,065 cells, open to the end of 1959.

Page: 'On July 1, 1960, the two territories united as planned to form the Somali Republic.' Dated 1960-07, outside the window (applied with a note); closes events/6. Cross-boundary: p1960-p1969 must check that the Somali Republic's 1960 found takes these cells.

Page: the constitution 'was approved ... in all of the territories except French Guinea' (28 Sep 1958); autonomous states within the Community 24 Nov (French Sudan) to 19 Dec 1958 (Niger); 'the territories that became Community member states did not form part of the French Republic'. Region: the seven country polygons (no Guinea, no Togo). Dated 1958-10 (the October 1958 constitution, the Fifth Republic's founding month), so the land is the Fifth Republic's before its Nov-Dec vassal_start events. Trial: every AOF cell except Guinea (1,149 to guinea) ends 1958 as Fifth Republic land in the vassal tint; nothing left to nobody. The page does not mention AOF's dissolution; the vassal model follows the dossier's ledger/5-14.

Page supports Chad, Gabon, the Middle Congo (28 Nov 1958) and Ubangi-Shari (1 Dec 1958) as Community member states. But the region added a 100 km circle around N'Djamena (the 'Fort Lamy strip', quoted from no opened page); the strip between the Logone and Chari lies inside Chad's polygon, and the trial showed the circle only moved 2 cells west of the Logone in Cameroon (14.61E 11.71N, 14.68E 12.11N) from AEF to the Fifth Republic's direct metropolitan land for 1958-59.
checks.fix: Dropped the N'Djamena circle; the region is now the union of Gabon, Republic of the Congo, Central African Republic and Chad (9,455 cells), with a reviewer note in the entry. Re-checked (14 ok) and re-trialled: events/9 moves no Cameroon cell; the 2 cells go with AEF's 18 other Cameroon/Rio Muni cells at its dissolve (see problems).

checks.what: Page: 'In 1953, Greenland's colonial status was ended and it was made an integral part of the Kingdom of Denmark'. Region the colony's Cliopatria 1940 shape (8,338 cells, bbox -72.4..-11.9 W, no Canadian land; a gain takes only Greenland's cells anyway). Trial: 8,338 cells to Denmark, 6 more by the dossier's dissolve; only 3 cells outside both shapes still go to nobody (-70.1/77.66, -36.94/65.8, -36.28/65.95).

Page: the new state 'would include all the territory of the former Dutch East Indies with the exception of Dutch New Guinea'; 'Sovereignty was formally transferred on 27 December 1949'. Correction = dossier correction plus all of Indonesia minus Papua/Papua Barat (5,601 cells). Trial: the 1953 snap adds 141 cells, all from nobody (Riau, Bangka-Belitung, Java/Kalimantan coasts, Natuna, Aru, Kai, Tanimbar), removes 1, 60 kept by others (RMS Seram etc.). The shape also holds 14 Malaysian border cells from Cliopatria (British colony keeps them by R1, 18 cell-years) and about 13 western New Guinea coastal cells that the Republic already held since 1950 (not new; see problems). Keyframe spans 1953-59 only (republic-of-indonesia_1960 follows).

Page: 'an Indian state in west-central India', 'created on 28 May 1948'; Rajpramukh 'from 28 May 1948 to 31 October 1956'. Trial: settles 578 cell-years in 1951, the 578 cells drawn constituent of India 1951 to the Nov 1956 merger. 1950 stays drawn as an independent state (no conflict that year, so no ruling can reach it): needs the hierarchy row the window already proposed.

Page: 'a short-lived state of India', 'formed through the merger of two former kingdoms, Travancore and Cochin on 1 July 1949'. Trial: settles 90 cell-years in 1951; the state drawn constituent of India 1951-56. 1950 still drawn independent: hierarchy row needed, as for Madhya Bharat.

patch_check: check-patch p1950-p1959 after the fix: 14 entries, 14 ok, 0 rejected; trial (to 1959): all 14 applied, events/7 dated 1960-07 (outside the window, applied with a note); rulings/0 settles 578 and rulings/1 90 cell-years; events/9 no longer moves Cameroon cells.
problems: hole 1950-52 (not fixed by this patch): 141 Indonesian island and coastal cells (Riau, Bangka-Belitung, Natuna, Aru, Kai, Tanimbar, Java/Kalimantan coast) are nobody's land from 1950 to the 1953 snap: 106 were nobody's on 1 Jan 1950, 26 were state-of-east-indonesia's, 9 were removed by the republic-of-indonesia_1950 keyframe snap. An override of republic-of-indonesia_1950 built like keyframe_overrides/0 (Indonesia without Papua/Papua Barat, same page) would close it.

events/1 side effect: republic-of-poland_1953 keyframe snap releases 6 Bug-border cells (23.2-23.9E, 52.1-53.4N) that events/1 gave Poland to nobody in 1953-59 (before the patch: Byelorussian SSR). Fix options: a republic-of-poland_1953 override adding the country polygon of Poland, or accept until p1960-p1969 events/1 (gain from the BSSR, falls back to nobody's land) takes them in 1960. The true date of the Białystok transfer (Aug 1945) remains a p1940-p1949 matter.

dossier french-equatorial-africa: its land holds 20 cells outside the four colonies (13 in Cameroon, incl. 2 at Kousseri west of the Logone, and 7 in Rio Muni) which go to nobody at its 1958 dissolve; they belong to French Cameroun (republic-of-cameroon, Fifth Republic vassal from Oct 1958) and Spanish Guinea. Its region text 'Neukamerun back after 1916' and the 'Fort Lamy strip' should be checked against a page.

dossier dutch-new-guinea (Papua + Papua Barat admin-1) misses about 13 coastal/island cells of western New Guinea (e.g. 137.19/-2.09, 140.18/-8.36, 133.78/-2.49, 130.71/-0.8) that the Republic of Indonesia holds 1950-62; the dutch-new-guinea_1949 correction should take the country-level coast (Indonesia's Papuan cells), not admin-1 only.

hierarchy rows still needed (proposed by the window): madhya-bharat -> republic-of-india constituent 1948-1956 and travancore-cochin -> republic-of-india constituent 1949-1956; with the rulings both are still drawn independent in 1950.
greenland: 3 cells (-70.1/77.66, -36.94/65.8, -36.28/65.95) lie outside both the colony shape and the country polygon and go to nobody at the 1953 dissolve.
cross-boundary: events/7 (1960-07, end of Italy's occupation of Somalia) lies in p1960-p1969; that window must check that the Somali Republic's July 1960 found takes the 2,065 cells.
